name: Can you live in the house during a whole-home renovation?

mainEntity.name: Can you live in the house during a whole-home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most homeowners find it practical to relocate temporarily during a full home remodel due to utility shutoffs, dust, and safety concerns. When a project simultaneously overhauls the kitchen, main bathrooms, and interior flooring, daily living without essential plumbing, cooking facilities, or quiet spaces becomes difficult. If you must remain on-site, discuss phasing strategies with your general contractor early, which may allow you to preserve an intact bathroom or living zone while other areas are under construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most homeowners relocate temporarily because water, power, kitchens, and bathrooms are often offline, though phased renovations can sometimes preserve a livable zone.
